craft.name: Bone Helmet · +2 Minion Gems
uncertainties: Current calculator probability and mean essence use are rounded; expected spending is indicative.
Comparable listings are asking prices, not completed sales. Whole-build fit and in-game execution are not established.
Starting-base acquisition must use exactly item level 75. Higher item levels can change the affix pool and require a separate cost model.
Acquire the Bone Helmet with at least 15% increased minion damage as an existing implicit. Greed and the resistance bench do not provide a missing input implicit.

steps.title: Roll minion levels and life
steps.action: Use Deafening Essence of Greed on the acquired rare Bone Helmet with at least 15% increased minion damage as an existing implicit.
steps.continueWhen: +2 to Level of all Minion Skill Gems, at least one open suffix and no native Fire Resistance.
steps.failureAction: If any stopping condition fails, repeat the essence on the same rare base; the native implicit is preserved. Do not pay for the bench before the whole core passes.

evidence.method: Current public CoE joint gem level, open suffix and no-fire calculation; ordinary paid failure and complete paid bench finish checked
evidence.settings: Acquired rare uninfluenced item level 75, unfractured, uncorrupted and unsynthesised, preserving native minion damage 15–20%. Deafening Essence of Greed guarantees 91–105 life. Stop only with +2 to all Minion Skill Gems AND at least one open suffix AND no native Fire Resistance. Then bench 29–35% Fire Resistance once for 3 Chaos Orbs.
evidence.assumptions: Expected 1907 rounded essence uses per completed item, including failures of the joint gem/vacancy/no-fire condition; one 3 Chaos Orb bench application and one acquired base. Same rare base reused, no Scouring. Any bench roll succeeds. No completed game craft, purchase, sale or whole-build fit is established.

steps.title: Craft resistance
steps.action: Bench craft 29–35% Fire Resistance in the open suffix.
steps.continueWhen: Required minion level, essence life and crafted Fire Resistance.
steps.failureAction: All 29–35% bench rolls pass. If the suffix is unavailable, the core did not satisfy the stopping conditions; return to paid essence rerolls.
